proposal:
SELECT
    s.zoneregistry AS site_code,
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    sc.structstate AS structural_condition,
    s.presstat AS status,
    CASE 
        WHEN s.envhaz = 'High' THEN 'Degradation Risk Zone'
        ELSE 'Not in Risk Zone'
    END AS risk_category
FROM 
    sites AS s
INNER JOIN 
    scanconservation AS sc ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
WHERE 
    s.envhaz = 'High';
